title: crocus neapolitanus
intro: Crocus neapolitanus, commonly known as the Neapolitan crocus, is a type of flowering bulbous perennial plant belonging to the Asphodelaceae family. This plant is known to possess various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Crocus neapolitanus include its use as a diuretic, which helps in reducing fluid retention and alleviating symptoms of urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
